heading: top-split
name: 左右分開的標題組＋單一面板直列清單
desc: 上方標題靠左、按鈕靠右，下方是一塊有底色的面板，裡面多個項目逐列排列，每列小標籤在左、標題在右。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方放標題組：標題靠左，按鈕靠右；標題組包含標題（可多行），右側可放一個圓形圖示按鈕並排一個文字連結，沒有時省略。標題組下方是一個直列清單，幾乎橫跨頁面內容寬度，整個清單是一塊有底色的面板，多個項目在面板裡每列一筆，列與列之間有分隔線。每列內由左到右排列：左側一個小標籤，右側緊接標題文字，兩者在列內垂直置中；項目沒有圖片。
mobile: 標題改為置中放在清單上方；每列改為直向堆疊，小標籤在上、標題文字在下，標題可多行，列與列之間仍有分隔線；圓形圖示按鈕與文字連結移到清單下方並置中。

en.name: Split heading group + single-panel list of rows
en.desc: A heading group with the title on the left and the button on the right, above one tinted panel holding multiple items as rows, each with a label on the left and a title on the right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, with the title on the left and the button on the right; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a round icon button placed side by side with a text link on the right; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a list of rows spanning nearly the full page content width; the whole list is one panel with a background fill, holding multiple items one per row, with dividers between rows. Within each row, from left to right: a label on the left and title text directly to its right, both vertically centered in the row; the items have no images.
en.mobile: The title becomes centered above the list; each row stacks vertically with the label above and the title text below, the title may wrap to multiple lines, and dividers between rows remain; the round icon button and text link move below the list, centered.
